profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, trading under the ticker TSM and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. Its website describes it as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987, supporting an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and design enablement solutions. The site also states that the company's business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The material available does not identify any AI-specific products, litigation, or MCP servers associated with the company. Its stated position rests on foundry manufacturing and design enablement for chip designers rather than on AI products of its own.
